nodes.label: HMI_TC_MAX_RPM Scale Number Requirement
nodes.rationale: Sample automotive system requirement mapping HMI_TC_MAX_RPM and HMI_TC_RED_START_RPM(a) inputs to a Scale Number output across RPM bands (6000/7000/8000/9000/10000 RPM), referencing the Godot Design spec — used as sample input for the AI test-case generation pipeline.

nodes.label: AI-Generated Test Cases Example (TC-Actual)
nodes.rationale: Illustrates a 16-named-column test-case table (Issue ID, Summary, Test Type, Issue Type, Project Key, Assignee, Description, Action, Data, Expected Result, Planned Execution, Test Case Type, Feature Group, Components, Labels, LinkTest) for TFDCX32348-137314_TC_001/002, including 'Feature Group' and 'LinkTest' columns matching the mandated Excel schema position, but expressed in the legacy Action/Data fields rather than the canonical test_steps/expected_result schema CLAUDE.md now mandates.
